const test=require('node:test'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),crypto=require('node:crypto');
const root=path.join(__dirname,'..'),changes=require('./fixtures/crypto-sentiment/chart-test-transitions.json'),h=x=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(x).digest('hex');
test('incoming Chart version and copy adjustments retain every prior assertion',()=>{for(const [file,d] of Object.entries(changes)){const before=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,d.predecessor),'utf8'),after=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,file),'utf8');assert.equal(h(before),d.predecessor_sha256);assert.equal(before.split(d.before).length-1,1);assert.equal(before.replace(d.before,d.after),after);assert.equal(h(after),d.current_sha256);}});
test('complete current Chart still satisfies the historical escaping and numeric preservation gates',()=>{const signed=require('./helpers/chart-signed-volume-preservation.cjs'),labels=require('./helpers/chart-html-labels-preservation.cjs');signed.normalize(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'jh-chart-engine.js'),'utf8'),'jh-chart-engine.js');labels.normalizeWhole(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,'jh-chart-indux.js'),'utf8'),'jh-chart-indux.js');});
